title: fix(core,react,i18n,components,console): a refused write on a read-only external object says the table is read-only, not that you lack permission

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg94yb5pVXBLeYzq5skXAbtg)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对外部只读表（数据源 allowWrites/对象 writable 不全为 true）写入被服务端拒绝时，新建/编辑表单、记录对话框、记录删除、列表行删除、行内编辑、日历拖动改期、阶段切换七处都改为提示「这张表是只读的：它的记录来自外部数据源，不接受修改。」（十种语言）。
- 为什么改：以前提示「您没有权限保存这条记录」或直接甩出英文诊断原文，管理员会去翻权限集，而任何权限集都解不开这张表。
- 风险与回滚：只按服务端错误码 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN 换文案，其他 403 和其他错误一字不变；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/core/src/utils/external-write-refusal.ts（判定只读 code）、ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx 的 refusalText、ui/packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts 的失败 toast。
- 两分钟验证：examples/app-showcase 跑 `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`，打开 External Customers 点「新建」填名称后创建，横幅应为上述只读提示，不再是「您没有权限保存这条记录。」
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Refs #30334 (item 2)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Item 2 of the card: "If a write still reaches the server, the message says the table is read-only, not that the user lacks permission."

The ADR-0015 write gate (objectql `assertWriteAllowed`) refuses a write on an object bound to an external datasource unless `datasource.external.allowWrites` AND `object.external.writable` are both true. Measured on a live boot (app-showcase, object `showcase_ext_customer` on datasource `showcase_external`): `POST`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/v1/data/showcase_ext_customer` each answer `403` with `{"error":"Write 'insert' blocked on object …","code":"EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN","object":"showcase_ext_customer"}`.

- **`@object-ui/core`: `isExternalWriteRefusal(err)`**, re-exported from `@object-ui/react` beside the other write-refusal readers. True only for the code the spec declares as `EXTERNAL_ERROR_CODES.writeForbidden`, read from `code` then `details.code` (the pair `isPermissionError` reads). It reads the server's verdict only; it re-derives nothing from the two flags.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: `form.readOnlyExternalSource`** in all ten packs.
- **Every surface that met this refusal now says it**, asked before `isPermissionError` (which claims every 403):
  - console record form page (`FormPage` `refusalText`), and the record dialog (`@object-ui/components` form) used by the list's 新建 and by 编辑;
  - record page header delete (`RecordDetailView`) and list row delete (`@object-ui/core` `recordDelete`), which showed the gate's raw English diagnostic;
  - record page inline edit (`InlineEditSaveBar`), which pinned the raw diagnostic on the edited field; now the read-only line, no field marked;
  - calendar drag-to-reschedule (`ObjectCalendar`) and record path stage change (`stageRefusalLines`), same class, not walked live.

Not in this PR (seat ruling on the claim): hiding New / Import / Edit / Delete on such an object is #30370 (the served `/auth/me/permissions` entry for the object reads `allowCreate/allowEdit/allowDelete: true` and `apiOperations` includes `create`, `update`, `delete`, `import`: `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` never reads the ADR-0015 gate), and the 在队列中 filter is #30372 (the spec plans the injected `queue` column on external objects too).

## Tests

- `FormPage.externalWriteRefusal-30334.test.tsx`: the form page's banner and toast for the gate's envelope, en and zh, plus a PERMISSION_DENIED control.
- `form-write-error-external-30334.test.tsx`: the record dialog, `code` and `details.code`, plus a FORBIDDEN control.
- `error-message.externalWriteRefusal-30334.test.ts`: the predicate, with controls (other 403 codes, `EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED` 422, the gate's text without its code).
- `stageRefusalLines.externalWrite-30334.test.ts`: the stage change lines, with a control.

## Acceptance notes

- Kanban card moves (`plugin-kanban`) read the refusal the same way and are left alone: that package is held by the in-flight #30220 claim.
- Flow runs whose write node meets the gate already say the server's own sentence, not the permission line (`flowFailureMessage` reads the inner refusal's text when `isPermissionError` is false for a status-less refusal); not changed.
- Bulk delete reports a count summary only; not changed.

## Verification

Live walk: `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4630`, console Vite against it, zh locale, signed in as the seeded admin. "Before" is the same boot with this PR's eight source files checked out at `fdad1786` (restored afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty). Screenshots are in the project files under `ui-seat3/30334/`.

| Surface | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 新建 → 创建 (`*-3-create-refused.png`) | 您没有权限保存这条记录。 | 这张表是只读的：它的记录来自外部数据源，不接受修改。 |
| 编辑 → 保存 (`*-4-edit-refused.png`) | 您没有权限保存这条记录。 | same read-only line |
| record header 删除 (`*-6-delete-refused.png`) | Write 'delete' blocked on object 'showcase_ext_customer': datasource 'showcase_external' is external … | same read-only line |
| list row 删除 (`*-7-row-delete-refused.png`) | 删除 External Customer 失败 + the raw diagnostic | 删除 External Customer 失败 + the read-only line |
| inline edit 保存 (`*-9-inline-edit-refused.png`) | the raw diagnostic, on the field | the read-only line, no field marked |

The source table was not changed by any of these writes (the gate refused each).
